This document is the explicitly confirmed ALTERNATIVE product profile: DeepSeek-v4-flash for the LLM and OCR/translation-support roles. Per 1R.6 it must never be selected silently and never serves as an automatic fallback for the default zhipu-coding-plan GLM-5.3-Flash profile recorded in role_registry.json; selection requires an explicit user confirmation argument. This registry records the confirmed alternative target profile only; it is credential-free and does not claim runtime readiness. Observed model identity belongs to a runtime ExecutionReservation receipt, never to registry text. OCR and translation declarations are identical to the default registry and unchanged by 1R.6.
